notes: NovaShell now spends less time animating when nothing is open, keeps the active floating app in front, and only checks for updates when you ask it to.
changes: The compact Orbit player drops to a low-cost idle check when it is closed instead of continuously rendering offscreen.
Relay raises as soon as it opens; interacting inside Orbit also reliably brings Orbit forward.
The release checker is now manual from Updates, so no surprise update modal interrupts first-run or fullscreen use.
Relay’s protected core-edit and removable Web Components app routes passed a reversible local smoke test.
